svg.aria-label: A 64-step smoke test on four nodes with quorum_size = 3. Nodes 0, 1 and 2 publish their snapshots in seconds, and every round closes with the three of them. Node 3 uploads at 60 KB/s: its first 26 MB snapshot takes about seven minutes, and lands after its round has closed and the round's objects have been cleaned up. Node 3 is in no round.
svg.text: A node at 60 KB/s is in no round
The other three close every round at quorum_size=3; node 3's first snapshot lands after its round is gone.
every round closes with nodes 0, 1 and 2
64 steps; each mark is a snapshot, uploaded in seconds
first snapshot: 26 MB at 60 KB/s, about 7 minutes
lands after its round closed and the round's objects were cleaned up
minutes (the upload to scale; the rest schematic)
The loss still fell: a quarter of every batch never reached the model. Since then, each node times a 26 MB PUT and refuses to join under 2 MB/s.
